cohort: Patients scheduled for Cesarean section at a hospital in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, between March 2020 and August 2021, categorized into normotensive and severe pre-eclamptic groups.
finding: While the percentage change in SBP, DBP, and MAP from baseline did not differ significantly between normotensive and severe pre-eclamptic parturients, normotensive parturients experienced a higher incidence of hypotension and required significantly more phenylephrine.
